dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000s4mj](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000s4mj) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 138.232 depth occurred on Jan 27 2026 20km W of Slahung. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -8.0323 longitude 111.2316. It impacted 2113211 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
